parts:
Josh


I've not seen this message previously, so it's a bit of a puzzle.  Taking the message literally, the software is complaining that it is unable to find a file "DistData.mdb" it expects to be located in a directory "D70Blickling_2016_mj.dat"  There is a description of the file structure used by Distance in the Distance Users Guide (ships with the software), Chapter 4 (from which I take this diagram):


My suggested remedy would be to port the old project to a directory with a less complex path name.  Several unpleasant things can happen when spaces exist in the path name.  After moving the project to a location with a "nicer" path name, try the upgrade process again.


If this fails, you might have your user export the project to a .zip archive file and send along to us; where we can perform the upgrade.


Note too I've copied this to our email support list should anyone else have this problem.


On 03/02/2017 11:34, Service Desk wrote:

Hi Guys,


We have a user who keeps getting the above error. It creates the file and the folder but still shows the above error when it's been upgraded. I had a look in your forums but couldn't find anything. Can you advise?
